title: Student's Camp
statementMd:
Alex studied well and won the trip to student camp Alushta, located on the seashore.

Unfortunately, it's the period of the strong winds now and there is a chance the camp will be destroyed! Camp building can be represented as the rectangle of $*n* + 2$ concrete blocks height and $*m*$ blocks width.

Every day there is a breeze blowing from the sea. Each block, except for the blocks of the upper and lower levers, such that there is no block to the left of it is destroyed with the probability ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d205a4be5f9d695a0646c69025e6a54ee3ac7d52.png). Similarly, each night the breeze blows in the direction to the sea. Thus, each block (again, except for the blocks of the upper and lower levers) such that there is no block to the right of it is destroyed with the same probability $*p*$. Note, that blocks of the upper and lower level are **indestructible**, so there are only $*n*·*m*$ blocks that can be destroyed.

The period of the strong winds will last for $*k*$ days and $*k*$ nights. If during this period the building will split in at least two connected components, it will collapse and Alex will have to find another place to spend summer.

Find the probability that Alex won't have to look for other opportunities and will be able to spend the summer in this camp.

## Input

The first line of the input contains two integers $*n*$ and $*m*$ ($1 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 1500$) that define the size of the destructible part of building.

The second line of the input contains two integers $*a*$ and $*b*$ ($1 ≤ *a* ≤ *b* ≤ 10^{9}$) that define the probability $*p*$. It's guaranteed that integers $*a*$ and $*b*$ are coprime.

The third line contains a single integer $*k*$ ($0 ≤ *k* ≤ 100 000$) — the number of days and nights strong wind will blow for.

## Output

Consider the answer as an irreducible fraction is equal to ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c443c7703e51f03d0eece0b96b9e84e425878209.png). Print one integer equal to ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/46a07a0832c5d2a29e7744cd0f78b236b5c8d22d.png). It's guaranteed that within the given constraints ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/4457f0abe60184adcf8d578febe006b800a12494.png).

## Note

In the first sample, each of the four blocks is destroyed with the probability ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/eb946338365d9781f7d2e9ec692c26702d0ae3a7.png). There are $7$ scenarios that result in building not collapsing, and the probability we are looking for is equal to ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d952828d9a444bd03168321a86984408b0e10b27.png), so you should print ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7f4efe64265b7f037ad984f8fd40cb932822d500.png)

statementZhMd:
Alex 学习成绩优异，赢得了前往位于海边的阿卢什塔学生营的旅行机会。

不幸的是，现在正值强风期，营地有可能会被摧毁！营地建筑可以表示为高为 *n* + 2 个混凝土方块、宽为 *m* 个方块的矩形。

每天都会有从海边吹来的微风。对于每个方块（上、下两层的方块除外），如果它的左侧没有方块，那么它会以 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d205a4be5f9d695a0646c69025e6a54ee3ac7d52.png) 的概率被摧毁。类似地，每天夜里微风会朝着海边的方向吹。因此，对于每个方块（同样不包括上、下两层的方块），如果它的右侧没有方块，那么它也会以相同的概率 $*p*$ 被摧毁。注意，上、下两层的方块是**不可摧毁的**，因此总共有 *n*·*m* 个可能被摧毁的方块。

强风期将持续 *k* 天 *k* 夜。如果在此期间建筑物分裂成至少两个连通部分，那么它就会倒塌，Alex 将不得不另找地方度过暑假。

求 Alex 不必寻找其他去处、能够在这个营地度过暑假的概率。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含两个整数 *n* 和 *m*（$1 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 1500$），表示建筑物中可摧毁部分的大小。

输入的第二行包含两个整数 *a* 和 *b*（$1 ≤ *a* ≤ *b* ≤ 10^{9}$），表示概率 *p*。保证整数 *a* 和 *b* 互质。

第三行包含一个整数 *k*（$0 ≤ *k* ≤ 100 000$）——强风将持续的天数和夜数。

## 输出格式

设答案的最简分数为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c443c7703e51f03d0eece0b96b9e84e425878209.png)。请输出一个等于 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/46a07a0832c5d2a29e7744cd0f78b236b5c8d22d.png) 的整数。在给定的约束条件下，可以保证 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/4457f0abe60184adcf8d578febe006b800a12494.png)。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，四个方块中的每一个都以 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/eb946338365d9781f7d2e9ec692c26702d0ae3a7.png) 的概率被摧毁。有 $7$ 种情形会导致建筑物不倒塌，因此所求概率等于 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d952828d9a444bd03168321a86984408b0e10b27.png)，所以应输出 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7f4efe64265b7f037ad984f8fd40cb932822d500.png)。
